title: Create Supabase client
body:
Add `supabase.ts` exporting a configured Supabase client using env vars.

**Acceptance**
- Client created with `createClient`.
- Exported for reuse.

**Tests**
- Unit test verifies client URL and anon key from env.

title: Implement `handle_new_user` trigger migration
body:
Create new migration in `supabase/migrations/` that adds `users` and `profiles` tables and a trigger to populate them on sign‑up.

**Acceptance**
- Tables created with appropriate columns and RLS.
- Trigger inserts rows on `auth.users` insert.

**Tests**
- Run migration locally and verify rows exist after mock sign‑up.

title: Add `useAuth` hook
body:
Create `src/hooks/useAuth.ts` handling login, logout, session retrieval using `@supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs`.

**Acceptance**
- Hook returns `{ user, loading, error, login, logout }`.
- Stores JWT in cookie.

**Tests**
- Unit test: login with mock client updates state.

title: Build login UI page
body:
Create `app/(auth)/login/page.tsx` with email/password and Google sign‑in buttons using the `useAuth` hook.

**Acceptance**
- Form validates input.
- Successful login redirects to dashboard.
- Errors displayed.

**Tests**
- Component test renders correctly.
- E2E login flow.

title: Build registration UI page
body:
Create `app/(auth)/register/page.tsx` similar to login, calling Supabase sign‑up.

**Acceptance**
- Registers new user, triggers migration rows.
- Redirects to login on success.

**Tests**
- E2E sign‑up flow verifies DB rows.

title: Write auth unit tests
body:
Add tests for `useAuth` hook covering login, logout, error handling.

**Acceptance**
- 100% coverage of hook logic.

**Tests**
- Jest tests with mocked Supabase client.

title: Create Job Type CRUD API
body:
Implement `/api/jobs` GET, POST, PUT, DELETE respecting JWT. Use shared Supabase client.

**Acceptance**
- All endpoints return proper shapes per `docs/api.md`.
- 401 on missing/invalid JWT.

**Tests**
- Integration tests for each endpoint.

title: Create Job Type UI list
body:
Add `app/jobs/page.tsx` showing list of job types with edit/delete buttons.

**Acceptance**
- Fetches from `/api/jobs`.
- UI updates after mutations.

**Tests**
- Component snapshot test.

title: Create Job Type UI form
body:
Add `app/jobs/new/page.tsx` and edit form supporting presets and custom fields.

**Acceptance**
- Preset fields auto‑populate.
- Validation prevents duplicate names.

**Tests**
- UI tests for field rendering.

title: Job Type API tests
body:
Write integration tests for job CRUD endpoints, covering auth, validation, and DB changes.

**Acceptance**
- All cases pass.

**Tests**
- Jest + supertest.

title: Implement Session Start API
body:
Create `/api/sessions/start` that creates a session with `started_at` and validates single active session per user.

**Acceptance**
- Returns 201 with session data.
- 409 if active session exists.

**Tests**
- Integration test for start and conflict.

title: Implement Session Stop API
body:
Create `/api/sessions/{id}/stop` that sets `ended_at` and stores `data`.

**Acceptance**
- Returns updated session.
- Validates ownership.

**Tests**
- Integration test for stop.

title: Create `useSession` hook
body:
Hook to start, stop, and track active session state using Supabase client.

**Acceptance**
- Exposes `startSession`, `stopSession`, `activeSession`.

**Tests**
- Unit tests for state transitions.

title: Build Session UI components
body:
Add start/stop buttons in dashboard, show timer, prompt for end‑of‑session fields.

**Acceptance**
- Button disabled when session active.
- Timer updates every second.

**Tests**
- Cypress E2E flow.

title: Live Session Timer logic (Zustand)
body:
Implement global timer store that calculates elapsed time from `started_at` and persists across reloads.

**Acceptance**
- Accurate HH:MM:SS display.
- Stops on session stop.

**Tests**
- Jest timer calculation tests.

title: Session History API
body:
Create `/api/sessions` with filters for job and date, returning only authenticated user's sessions.

**Acceptance**
- Supports query params.

**Tests**
- Integration tests for filtering.

title: Session History UI dashboard
body:
Add `app/sessions/page.tsx` displaying session cards, totals per job, pagination, and edit links.

**Acceptance**
- Correct totals shown.

**Tests**
- Snapshot and Cypress tests.

title: Edit Session Audit API
body:
Add `PUT /api/sessions/{id}` requiring `audit_note`, logging changes to `session_edit_audit_log`.

**Acceptance**
- 400 on missing note.
- Log entry created.

**Tests**
- Unit test for middleware, DB verification.

title: Edit Session UI with audit note
body:
Update session edit page to require audit note before saving.

**Acceptance**
- Note field mandatory.

**Tests**
- E2E edit flow validates note.

title: Forgotten Session Reminder cron job
body:
Add Supabase `pg_cron` job and `/api/sessions/remind` endpoint to email users after threshold.

**Acceptance**
- Hourly cron triggers email after 8h, 16h.
- `reminder_sent_at` prevents repeats.

**Tests**
- Integration test for endpoint with mocked Resend.
- Unit test for cron query.

title: Per‑Job Configuration fields
body:
Extend job schema with `hourly_rate`, `tax_percentage`, `km_deduction_rate`, `custom_deductions`. Add UI controls on job edit page.

**Acceptance**
- Values saved in job `data` JSONB.
- Validation enforced.

**Tests**
- Validation unit tests, API update test, UI persistence test.

title: IRD Reporting endpoint
body:
Create `/api/reports/ird` that aggregates business kilometres and earnings per month, returns CSV. Add UI download button.

**Acceptance**
- CSV matches spec in `docs/api.md`.

**Tests**
- E2E generate report and compare fixture.

title: Generate OpenAPI spec
body:
Produce OpenAPI spec covering all endpoints, ensure JWT validation, CORS, versioning. Add mobile integration tests.

**Acceptance**
- Spec passes Swagger validation.

**Tests**
- CI step validates spec, runs mobile tests.

title: Configure CI pipeline
body:
Set up GitHub Actions to run ESLint, Prettier, TypeScript compile, Jest on each PR. Enforce Conventional Commits.

**Acceptance**
- CI fails on lint/type errors.

**Tests**
- Verify actions trigger on PR.

title: Update project documentation
body:
Refresh `README.md` with quick‑start, link to architecture, API, auth docs. Add index of tickets.

**Acceptance**
- No broken links.

**Tests**
- Run docs check script.
